Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace promotional credit for 3-month pilot

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and the batching options. We're planning a limited 3-month pilot of a customer-facing feature that uses embeddings/structured outputs and we'd like to list the offering on the AWS Marketplace during the pilot so customers can subscribe easily.

Quick ask: to make the listing attractive to pilot customers, can Redwood offer a marketplace promotional credit (applied as a short-term listing rebate) that we can reference on the store page? Target: $30k in list credits (applied over three months) or an equivalent percentage discount applied to the marketplace price.

Notes:
- Pilot expected to generate ~60k tokens/day at peak (engineering estimates attached SOW).
- Decision timeline: procurement review by 4/8.
- Commercial lead: procurement@solaris-energies.com

If this is something the deal desk needs to approve, pleased to be looped in. We can share a short customer-facing blurb for the listing and any procurement forms you need.

Best,
Lina Park
Director, Product & Ops
Solaris Energies

Attachments: Solaris_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf (7 pages, project plan, estimated usage)

Subject: Fwd: AWS Marketplace promotional credit for 3-month pilot (Solaris Energies) — request for exception

Team — forwarding a request from Solaris Energies (details above). Summary: they want a $30k promotional credit applied to the AWS Marketplace listing for a 3-month pilot starting mid-April. Procurement wants confirmation by 4/8.

Why exception: this is a short-term marketplace listing promo (not part of standard volume-based credits).

Business case highlights:
- Pilot is with a vertically relevant energy platform that could expand to enterprise seat licenses (estimated ARR uplift ~ $220k/year if GA)
- Public listing will accelerate adoption vs. private purchase flow
- Solaris has strong channel relationships in EMEA which could help our regional GTM

Numbers: Solaris expects peak token usage ~60k/day (short-term). If we grant $30k credit, expected net yield to Redwood after marketplace fees is estimated ~ $16k across the three months (finance input needed).

Requested action: deal desk + finance approval for up to $30k promotional credit OR approval for a tiered discount (e.g., 25–30% off list for three months). If approved, we'd like to publish the listing with the promotional blurb and share DocuSign wrapper with Solaris to accept the pilot SOW.

Please advise required sign-off level and whether we should route via marketplace special offers or a seller-issued rebate.

Thanks,
Diego

--- Forwarded message attached above ---

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, deal-desk@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: AWS Marketplace promotional credit for 3-month pilot (Solaris Energies)

Diego + team — tagging in. Quick thoughts:

1) Commercial recommendation: authorize up to $30k of gross marketplace promotional credit, but structure it as a tiered, time-limited listing promo where the credit is paid as a seller marketing rebate tied to usage thresholds (this reduces churn risk). Recommend: 15k guaranteed credit up front (applied pro rata on listing) + 15k paid on attainment (>50% of expected usage during month 2).

2) Risk controls: cap total credit burn to $30k; require Solaris to sign the pilot SOW and accept our standard pilot terms (30-day termination, usage reporting).

3) Finance sign-off required for the payment structure (seller-paid rebate). Markus, can you confirm if we can fund $30k as a seller marketing rebate from current FY27 campaign budget and whether it needs PO/GL coding?

Diego — pls prepare a short one-pager with the proposed structure and move the DocuSign draft to Solaris once we have markus sign-off.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Fwd: AWS Marketplace promotional credit for 3-month pilot (Solaris Energies) — finance approval

Aditya / Diego — reviewed. Finance can approve a seller-funded marketplace promotional credit capped at $30,000 gross under the following constraints:

- Structure: 50% upfront credit applied to marketplace listing (as a seller marketing promotion visible to customers) + 50% conditional payout (seller rebate) upon reaching 50% of the expected usage threshold during month 2.
- Accounting: code to GL 6603 (Sales Promotions); we need a PO from Solaris for the pilot SOW and a short internal memo for audit (I attached Approved_PO_SOL-1245.pdf).
- Duration: promo must be limited to a 3-month window; any extension requires a new approval.
- Reporting: require weekly usage export (CSV) and one mid-pilot checkpoint with Revenue Ops.

Please confirm that the marketplace operations team can publish the listing with the promotional blurb and that legal will sign off on the Marketplace_Promo_Terms_draft. Once confirmed, I'll prepare the accounting entry and sign-off memo.

Markus Klein
VP Finance | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: Approved_PO_SOL-1245.pdf
